title: 2020-21 Panini Mosaic #170 Andre Drummond Los Angeles Lakers Basketball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2020-21 Panini Mosaic sports trading card features Andre Drummond, a professional basketball player for the Los Angeles Lakers. The card is a part of the 2020-21 Panini Mosaic set and has the card number 170. It is a parallel/variety Mosaic card manufactured by Panini. 

The card is perfect for any NBA fan or collector who wants to add a piece of basketball history to their collection. It is an excellent way to remember the 2020-21 season and the incredible performances that Drummond had on the court. This trading card is a must-have for any Andre Drummond or Los Angeles Lakers fan.
